mathematical_checks.proof: r=1/(1+sum w); G=sum(w kkT)/(1+sum w); H=sum(w kvT)/(1+sum w). Norm(k)<=1 and coordinatewise |v|<=1 imply PSD G, trace(G)<=1, each column ||H_j||<=1. A=G+.01I has eigenvalues [.01,1.01], condition<=101, and |q^T A^-1 H_j|<=100. These are exact-arithmetic bounds, not uniform long-time BPTT guarantees.

solve_adjoint_checks.interpretation: Original finite-difference failures remain unchanged; the analytic adjoint and full declared step sweep diagnose precision separately from training performance.

query_and_resources.runner_fixed_operator_bytes_means: Source float64 arrays, not runtime FP32 table; frozen field is retained
query_and_resources.contract: Final query does not write G/H/r; it does update fast/slow states and current residual. Only x and dt enter apply_model; labels are used by loss/metrics, never inference. All input coordinates use generic learned dense maps; there is no task/marker/answer dispatch.
query_and_resources.complexity: Prefix update O(K^2+Kh), learned value projection O(h^2), final solve O(K^3+K^2h). One K=16 solve per sequence; this is not a measured token-by-token decoder.

dataset_audit.scope: Whole-dataset SHA plus exact (x,dt) input overlap against all v3/development/v4 training and between v4 evaluation splits. Repeated examples within short finite training tasks are not forbidden. The same task/seed data are intentionally paired across all seven models.
